capabilities: Sync notes, canvases and attachments through Quark Drive
Preview and confirm the first sync before changes apply
Browse Quark Drive and insert file links into notes
Restore earlier versions and resolve conflicts
Download attachments on demand to save device space
extras: Uses Quark Drive's unofficial web API, so API or permission changes can interrupt sign-in or sync; iOS/iPadOS transport has not been verified on a physical device; settings default to Simplified Chinese; manual installation from GitHub Releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through Quark Drive across desktop and mobile devices.

relations.evidence: Sync Obsidian notes, canvases, and attachments through Quark Drive

summary: Syncs notes, canvases and attachments through Quark Drive between Windows, Android and iOS devices, with a dashboard, version history and conflict resolution.
